intent: Technical Brief: Dell Alienware System State Baseline
detected_fault: Thermal throttling due to inadequate cooling (radiator orientation)
Potential for air bubbles in the pump block of the AIO cooler
Non-XMP enabled RAM may not be utilizing its full potential
suggested_solution: Reorient the radiator to ensure that the tubes exit at the top
Enable XMP profile on the RAM
Consider undervolting the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070TI
